Receive The Light

The Light is emailed to the parish each month. To be added to the list, ask the parish office, or write to newsletter@ntgoc.org — the same address that receives announcements and articles. Someone adds you by hand, and that is the only way in at the moment.

Proposed — no sign-up exists today

A form on this page would save the asking. What one might look like is drafted on the welcome page; no list software has been chosen, and nothing typed into it is sent or stored.
